title: Sparse autoencoders

paper.title: Towards Monosemanticity: Decomposing Language Models With Dictionary Learning
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Sparse autoencoders: fit a sparse dictionary to frozen activations and report reconstruction versus L0 with dead-feature counts. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use frozen-activation-fixture; required output: Frozen activations -> reconstruction and sparse codes. Evaluate reconstruction_mse (minimize). Report L0 reconstruction error dead features and decoder normalization. Required ablation: Sweep sparsity penalty at fixed dictionary width and activation sample count. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
